snippets.relevance_rationale: Definiert den Einstiegspunkt für Netzwerk-Zustandswechsel vom ComM in das LIN-Cluster.
snippets.verbatim_text: [SWS_ComM_00135] If the channel is of bus type LIN and a communication mode transition is requested, the Communication Manager shall call LinSM_RequestComMode to coordinate network state changes.

snippets.relevance_rationale: Verbindliche Kopplung von State-Manager und Interface bei Schedule-Umschaltungen.
snippets.verbatim_text: [SWS_LinSM_00079] If the function LinSM_ScheduleRequest is called, the LinSM module shall forward (and not wait for the next main function call) the request to the LinIf module using the function call LinIf_ScheduleRequest.

snippets.relevance_rationale: Definiert die Einspeisung von PDU-Sendeanforderungen aus dem PduR in das LIN-Cluster.
snippets.verbatim_text: Routing table entry: TargetFctPtr: LinIf_Transmit. Description: Multicast using CanIf and LinIf. Note that for LinIf this is a sporadic frame (will later be a TriggerTransmit call).

snippets.relevance_rationale: Rückmeldung des erfolgreichen Busversands vom LIN-Cluster an den PDU Router.
snippets.verbatim_text: Example: The LinIf will call PduR_LinIfTxConfirmation upon successful completion of the frame transmission on the physical bus.

snippets.relevance_rationale: Kopplung zwischen Transceiver, Interface und Low-Level-Treiber zur Wakeup-Signal-Validierung.
snippets.verbatim_text: [SWS_Lin_00098] After a wake up caused by LIN bus Transceiver the function Lin_CheckWakeup will be called by the LIN Interface module to identify the corresponding LIN channel (see SWS_LinIf_00503). In this case, LIN Driver only plays a role on validation of this wake up signal.

snippets.relevance_rationale: Synchrones Umschalten der physikalischen Bus-Transceiver über das LinIf.
snippets.verbatim_text: [SWS_LinTrcv_00015] The LinTrcv module shall switch the transceiver hardware into the requested operating mode (NORMAL, SLEEP, STANDBY) synchronously when LinTrcv_SetOpMode is invoked.

snippets.relevance_rationale: Grundlegendes Architekturkonzept für das LIN-Subsystem in der AUTOSAR-Schichtenarchitektur.
snippets.verbatim_text: Integration of LIN into AUTOSAR: LIN Interface controls the WakeUp/Sleep API and allows the slaves to keep the bus awake (decentralized approach). When sending a LIN frame, the LIN Interface requests the data for the frame (I-PDU) from the PDU Router at the point in time when it requires the data (i.e. right before sending the LIN frame).

snippets.relevance_rationale: Spezifikation der Diagnose- und Transportprotokoll-Schnittstelle im LIN-Cluster.
snippets.verbatim_text: [SWS_LinIf_00351] The LIN Transport Layer (LinTp) shall provide transport protocol services according to ISO 17987 for diagnostic requests (Dcm) and segmented data communication.
